simple.meaning: נְטֹפָתִי (Nᵉṭôphâthîy) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “a Netophathite , or inhabitant of Netophah.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 11 times across 2 Samuel, 2 Kings, 1 Chronicles, Nehemiah, Jeremiah, beginning at 2 Samuel 23:28. Its contexts include family line, kingship.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to נְטֹפָתִי (H5200).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: נְטֹפָתִי (Nᵉṭôphâthîy) / H5200 is traced through 2 Samuel 23:28, 2 Samuel 23:29, 2 Kings 25:23, 1 Chronicles 2:54 as a generated source-based concept entry.

definitions.short: a Netophathite , or inhabitant of Netophah
definitions.full: H5200. Netophathi נְטוֺפָתִי נְטֹפָתִי, adjective, of a people ; — ׳נְטֹפ 2Sam 23:28 5 t., ׳נְטוֺפ 1Chr 2:54 4 t. Chronicles; — ׳הַנּ the Netophathite 2Sam 23:28-29 , 2Kin 25:23 = Jer 40:8 ; 1Chr 11:30 (twice in verse); singular collective (the) Netophathites (no article) 2:54 ; 9:16 ; Neh 12:28 .

The tenth captain for the tenth month was Maharai the Netophathite, of the Zerahites. In his division were twenty-four thousand.
The twelfth captain for the twelfth month was Heldai the Netophathite, of Othniel. In his division were twenty-four thousand.
The sons of the singers gathered themselves together, both out of the plain around Jerusalem and from the villages of the Netophathites;

then Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, and Johanan and Jonathan the sons of Kareah, and Seraiah the son of Tanhumeth, and the sons of Ephai the Netophathite, and Jezaniah the son of the Maacathite, they and their men came to Gedaliah to Mizpah.
